title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1968-08-22

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear soundboard capture of the second half of the legendary 8/22/68 Fillmore West show, highlighted by a spectacular drum solo and inventive versions of Feedback, The Eleven and Other One > New Potato.
ai_review.review: The Jools‑sourced recording delivers an exceptionally clean board mix that lets listeners hear every nuance of what many consider a peak Dead performance.  Even though only the second half is present, reviewers rave about the standout drum solo, inventive “Feedback,” and powerful runs through The Eleven, Dark Star, Death Don't Have No Mercy and Other One > New Potato.

ai_rating.rationale: All six reviews are strongly positive (average 4.5★); the show is praised as a top‑tier performance and the soundboard recording is described as crystal clear.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crystal‑clear mix with classic ’68 Fillmore board sound; no noticeable dropouts, though only the second half of the concert is present.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Only the second half of the 8/22 show is included, missing some earlier gems, but the material present maintains high energy and showcases a peak‑era Dead performance.

band_member_comments.Drums: Reviewers call this the best drum solo to date and note its crystal‑clear sound on the board recording.
